synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO market notices from other NEM regions in the searched window did not explicitly report an 'SA1 price spike'; they reported inter‑regional transfer constraints/outages and non‑conformance items.

document_statements.quote: At 1100 hrs 31/07/2026 there was a short notice outage of South Morang-Sydenham No.1 500 kV line.
In order to maintain the power system in a secure operating state in the VIC region, AEMO has invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597B5710 from 0130 hrs until further notice.
The outage has been completed and Directlink all 3 cables returned to service at 1430 hrs 31/07/2026 Constraint set(s) revoked: N-X_MBTE_3
A planned outage of Avon - Marulan 16 330 kV Line in the NSW region was scheduled from 0700 hrs 29/07/2026 to 1700 hrs 01/08/2026.

AEMO has declared the following unit as non-conforming under clause 3.8.23 of the National Electricity Rules: Unit: WTAHB1 Duration: 29/07/2026 13:55 to 29/07/2026 14:15 Amount: 52 MW Constraint: NC-N_WTAHB1

NON-CONFORMANCE QLD1 Region Wednesday, 29 July 2026 AEMO has declared the following unit as non-conforming under clause 3.8.23 of the National Electricity Rules: Unit: LILYSF1 Duration: 29/07/2026 12:40 to 29/07/2026 12:45 Amount: 56 MW Constraint: NC-Q_LILYSF1 Auto-generated on behalf of Manager NEM Real Time Operations

possible_explanations.statement: Constraint and outage notices that name the V‑SA interconnector (the South Morang‑Sydenham line notice [c1] and the VIC constraint automation notice [c2]) may be related to contemporaneous SA dispatch conditions; comparing their invocation times with SA dispatch prices and interconnector flows would test that.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the constraint invocation at 2026-07-31T01:00:00Z (the VIC notice's UTC time for 1100 hrs 31/07/2026) with SA dispatch prices and V‑SA flows at 2026-07-31T01:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The Directlink return‑to‑service notice for NSW (the Directlink notice [c3]) might be associated with changes in inter‑regional flows around the same window; checking NETINTERCHANGE and prices either side of the service‑return time would test that.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare NETINTERCHANGE and regional 5‑minute RRPs around 2026-07-31T04:30:00Z (the Directlink return UTC time) with earlier and later intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: Non‑conformance notices in NSW and QLD (the NSW non‑conformance [c5] and QLD non‑conformance [c6]) might be unrelated operational items; verifying their durations and timing against SA price intervals would test whether they temporally overlap the SA price event.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the non‑conformance durations shown in [c5] and [c6] (their quoted date/time ranges) with SA dispatch interval times.
